entries.name: plate-detector-createml-v1
entries.license: PlateWatch (trained by this project); training images CC BY 2.0 (Open Images V7 'Vehicle registration plate' annotations CC BY 4.0) - per-image attribution in the provenance file
entries.inputDescription: IMAGE 416x416 RGB; Create ML Object Detection pipeline (neural network + NMS); single class 'plate'; outputs confidence/coordinates MultiArrays via VNCoreMLRequest
entries.notes: Home-trained Create ML detector (2000 iterations). Won the head-to-head against plate-detector-yolov8n on the 62-image corpus (plate reads 19/62 vs 17/62, fleet recall 63% vs 61%, precision 100% both; see docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-13). Single-file .mlmodel compiles directly after download.

entries.name: plate-detector-yolov8n
entries.license: AGPL-3.0 (model weights used per upstream terms; see registry notes)
entries.inputDescription: IMAGE 640x640 BGR letterboxed; YOLOv8 license plate detection
entries.notes: Converted from joker5914/yolov8n-license-plate (Ultralytics YOLOv8). Apple-Archived (.aar); VehicleML.ModelArchive extracts before compile. Superseded by plate-detector-createml-v1 (0.2.0) as the head-to-head loser, kept as fallback.

entries.name: vehicle-detector-yolov8n
entries.inputDescription: IMAGE 640x640 BGR letterboxed; YOLOv8 COCO detection heads
entries.notes: COCO vehicle classes (car, truck, bus, motorcycle) gate the fleet classifier stages; fine-tune on fleet imagery later (ROADMAP M2). A COCO detector never vouches for a fleet class (see PlateAnalysisPipeline fusion rules).

entries.name: vehicle-type-classifier
entries.inputDescription: IMAGE 224x224 RGB; ViT-B/16 10 vehicle types (car, truck, bus, motorcycle, bicycle, etc.)
entries.notes: 10-class vehicle type classifier. Used to route detection to specialized stages. Palettization skipped (coremltools API drift); float16 weights.

entries.name: vehicle-make-model-classifier
entries.inputDescription: IMAGE 224x224 RGB; ViT-B/16 car model classifier
entries.notes: Fine-grained car make+model classifier (ViT-B/16). Outputs make/model probabilities.

entries.name: vehicle-reid-osnet-x0_25
entries.inputDescription: IMAGE 128x256 RGB; outputs 512-dim embedding (OSNet x0.25 on MSMT17)
entries.notes: OSNet x0.25 trained on MSMT17 (person re-ID), transfers to vehicle re-ID. Converted via deep-person-reid (torchreid) PyTorch trace -> CoreML mlprogram. Complements the Vision feature-print fallback.
